_what_this_is: The founder reserves spending money on a paid model seat to himself. Until
2026-09-20 that constraint was enforced as an ABSENCE predicate: 'no round
dated after the cut holds a paid seat reply'. That is the wrong proposition.
It is false the moment he authorises a paid review, and the only ways to make
it green again are to move the date cut forward or to delete the guard --
both of which silently license the NEXT unauthorised spend.
This file replaces it with an AUTHORISATION predicate, which is strictly
stronger: every paid seat reply must fall inside a round named here. A paid
dispatch in any round NOT named here fails the guard, whatever its date, so
the check now also covers rounds before the old cut, which it did not.
RULES FOR EDITING. Rounds are named EXACTLY and individually. Never a date
range, never a name prefix, never a wildcard: the guard must keep asking
'was this authorised?' and must never drift into asking 'is this recent?'.
Every entry carries the founder's own words, so a reader can check the
authorisation rather than trust the entry.
